command:
set -euo pipefail
SUBJECT=decdc08c07ef3893fdb558fba2eddb9e45983d94
ROOT=/tmp/crush008-main-selector-0930
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/src/.git" ]; then git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git "$ROOT/src"; fi
cd "$ROOT/src"
git fetch -q origin main
git checkout -q --detach "$SUBJECT"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SUBJECT"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/fakebin"
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'echo go version go0.0.1 linux/amd64' > "$ROOT/fakebin/go"
chmod 755 "$ROOT/fakebin/go"
TEST_PATH="$ROOT/fakebin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
echo SUBJECT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo FAKE_GO=$(PATH="$TEST_PATH" go version)
PATH="$TEST_PATH" ./scripts/validate-research-surface.sh
PATH="$TEST_PATH" ./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh inspect
PATH="$TEST_PATH" ./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh stage
PATH="$TEST_PATH" ./scripts/ai-core-node-test-platform.sh verify-stage
echo CRUSH008_MAIN_SELECTOR_CLOSEOUT_PASS
